source: New optional post-dispatch transit stock, using previously tested IGCMolecules.BoundedQueue. Original S2 upstream and native Modelica remain fixed.

stages.purpose: Accepted work waits for physical preparation
Finished units are ready for departure
Physically shipped goods remain in transit before being received
stages.semantic_condition: Receipt occurs after shipment, and in-transit goods are accumulated
stages.parameters: Trusted transitCapacity and transitResponseTime; hidden from LLM

guarantee: Optional additions are enumerated from typed graph contracts. This scope has only 2 models, no free graph topology or novel equation synthesis.
library: OpenModelica 1.26.5 with SystemDynamics v2.1.2 and Modelica Standard Library v4.0.0
